Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner confused the generational relationship and incorrectly identified the paternal grandfather as Louis Philippe I, Duke of Orléans (1725–1785), i.e., the grandfather of Louis Philippe I, instead of the correct person, Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans (Philippe Égalité), who is the father of Louis Philippe I and thus Charles’s actual paternal grandfather.
